archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-07.4 Monitor Quality and Compliance Indicators
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Next, the organization measures and monitors how well it adheres to governance and quality standards. This involves defining key quality dimensions — such as accuracy, timeliness, consistency, comparability, and accessibility — and measuring performance against them.
Automated dashboards and audits are used to detect deviations or weaknesses in processes. When issues are identified, they are escalated for corrective action and recorded for reporting.
Continuous monitoring ensures that the organization stays within its quality and compliance targets at all times.
Value created: Measurable assurance that data and processes meet defined quality and compliance standards.
